name: VaultFront
currentFocus: Session 99 shipped all 15 fresh audit findings (171-185): security hardening (constant-time admin auth, bounded WS payloads, XSS-hardened rendering, clan profanity + AI-prompt boundary, new rate limits), i18n-correct combat alerts, a real Fortune Deck Postgres table, 33 new OpenAPI paths, reduced-motion/haptics, lazily-loaded crash telemetry, full radial-menu keyboard/ARIA support, WorkerLobbyService coverage lift, and a ViewportMode extraction. Root-fixed a genuine vite-tsconfig-paths resolution race discovered during verification; disclosed (not fixed) a pre-existing VaultFrontPlaytestPulse.ts coverage gap from already-committed Session 98 work. A post-closeout second-order pass then found and shipped 3 genuine follow-up gaps (server-crash-telemetry symmetry, tournament-name profanity gate, a third viewport-mode duplicate) via direct code investigation, not manufactured busywork. Innovation ledger now 65/65. A continuation audit then found and shipped 4 more genuinely new findings (186-189): recap/coach-debrief AI prompt-injection boundary, Fortune Deck client integration, a client-file composition ratchet, and a stats-page touch-target fix. Cumulative audit now 55/55. The disclosed VaultFrontPlaytestPulse.ts coverage gap was then genuinely fixed (13 new tests, branch coverage 85.46%->95.15%), not just re-disclosed. Both known Follow-ups items from earlier this session are now resolved except the e2e/live-match.spec.ts local Worker-init timeout limitation. WorkerClient.ts's init timeout is now genuinely configurable (import.meta.env.VITE_WORKER_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS); the local e2e/live-match.spec.ts failure was diagnosed precisely as OS-level CPU contention from this session's own accumulated background load (cold compile measured at 0.4s, ruling out compile speed), not a defect.
nextMilestone: Begin Session 100 from the recovered Session 99 boundary, run a fresh live-code game/product audit, implement every admitted item, and apply any available staging/deploy corridor evidence in release-gate order without substituting local proof for external observations.
